regler_sql: SELECT navn, ticker, 1 AS andel,mcap FROM aksjekurs WHERE dato = (SELECT MAX(dato) FROM aksjekurs) ORDER BY mcap DESC

SELECT a.navn, a.ticker, 1 AS andel, k.mcap, a.estimert_mcap_aar, k.mcap / a.estimert_mcap_aar AS overvurdering           FROM aksjer a JOIN aksjekurs k ON a.ticker = k.ticker WHERE NOT a.regnskap_organisasjonsnummer is null AND k.dato = (SELECT MAX(dato) FROM aksjekurs) AND a.estimert_mcap_aar IS NOT NULL AND k.mcap IS NOT NULL AND a.prosent_dager_omsetning > 50 AND a.estimert_mcap_aar > 0 AND NOT a.estimert_mcap_aar is NULL ORDER BY overvurdering DESC

SELECT a.navn, a.ticker, 1 AS andel, k.mcap, a.estimert_mcap_aar, k.mcap / a.estimert_mcap_aar AS overvurdering FROM aksjer a JOIN aksjekurs k ON a.ticker = k.ticker JOIN aarsregnskap_siste ar ON ar.organisasjonsnummer = a.regnskap_organisasjonsnummer WHERE NOT a.regnskap_organisasjonsnummer is null AND k.dato = (SELECT MAX(dato) FROM aksjekurs) AND a.estimert_mcap_aar IS NOT NULL AND k.mcap IS NOT NULL AND a.prosent_dager_omsetning > 50 AND a.estimert_mcap_aar > 0 AND NOT a.estimert_mcap_aar is NULL ORDER BY overvurdering ASC
